loanDetailsHtml:
What is an OnlyFans creator cash advance?

A creator cash advance provides business funding based on your earnings history. PennyLime purchases a portion of your future receivables and provides the amount in your accepted offer. For an OnlyFans creator, the application starts with the income that reaches your bank account, not a follower milestone or a traditional employer pay stub.

This is separate from withdrawing your OnlyFans balance. PennyLime does not control pending platform payouts, release money held by OnlyFans, or act on the platform's behalf. It is an independent funding option for business expenses, with its own application, agreement, and repayment obligations.

Business expenses an advance can help cover

  • Equipment and setup: cameras, lenses, lighting, microphones, computers, and a dedicated workspace.
  • Production costs: editing software, storage, props, supplies, and contractor invoices.
  • Marketing and audience development: design work, a creator website, and promotion permitted by the services you use.
  • Operating cash flow: business bills that fall due before expected creator earnings arrive.

Choose an amount for a specific business need. If an expense has an immediate deadline, factor in the funding window before applying: funds can take up to 10 business days to reach your account after you accept your approved offer.

Who can apply?

PennyLime accepts applications from U.S. residents aged 18 or older who operate a business and have a verifiable bank account. OnlyFans creators can apply using their creator earnings. Approval depends on underwriting, including verified income and existing financial obligations.

Variable monthly earnings do not make an application the same as someone else's. A single successful month, a large subscriber count, or a requested advance amount does not guarantee approval. Be prepared to show recent deposits so the review can assess the business behind the application.

How to document your creator income

Use the bank account where your creator earnings actually arrive. Have recent income records available and complete the identity and bank-verification steps in the application. You may be asked for supporting documents if more information is needed to review your earnings.

  • Check that the name and account details you provide are accurate.
  • Include the business income sources requested in the application.
  • Keep recent statements or payout records available if requested.
  • Respond to verification requests through PennyLime's application or support channels.

Read the privacy policy and information security overview to understand how application information is handled. Questions about the application can be sent to info@pennylime.com.

Understand the cost before you accept

Your approved offer explains the amount you receive, the total repayment, any fees, and the remittance schedule. Read those figures together. A lower recurring payment does not, by itself, tell you the total cost of funding.

Use the advance calculator for an estimate, then rely on the actual offer and agreement for your terms. Compare the scheduled payments with your regular production costs and expected deposits. You can review an offer before deciding whether to accept it.

Allow up to 10 business days for funds to arrive

Applying, receiving an approval decision, accepting your offer, and receiving the money are different steps. After you accept your approved offer, funds can take up to 10 business days to reach your bank account. Weekends and federal holidays do not count as business days.

Do not treat an approval or a pending transfer as money available to spend. Check your bank's available balance before committing the funds. If you have already applied, use Check Status to review your application.

Funding for a business with more than one income source

If you also earn through subscriptions, streaming, video, or freelance work, provide the income information requested in your application. You can explore PennyLime's pages for Patreon creators, Twitch streamers, and YouTube creators, or view all supported platforms.

OnlyFans is a trademark of its respective owner. PennyLime is an independent provider and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OnlyFans.
